doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Pops Foster's account of the 1918 flu
summary: Rowe recounts Pops Foster's autobiography mentioning time off from riverboat playing during the Spanish flu; Peplowski loves such oral histories.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: It’s very interesting I was reading a book about Pops Foster and he’s talking about playing on the Mississippi riverboats in 1918 and then he said, just in passing, “And we
had to take a few months off because of this flu thing.” Right? He’s talking about the Spanish flu which really struck me as it’s come around or something.
Yeah, interesting, yeah. Is that his autobiography that one?
Yeah. I’ll send you the title. It’s a great read.
Yeah I think I missed that one. I’ve got to read that.
I love those oral histories like that.
